section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1976
title: PART II SUICIDES IN INDIA SUICIDES A total of 41415 suicides were reported during the year 1975 compared with the figure of 42,890 in 1975 (-3.4%). The numerical decrease registered during 1976 over 1975 was 1475. During the period 1969-76, the trend in suicides cases has been erratic. While the period 1969-70 registered an upward trend, there was a downward trend in the period 1971-73. The year 1974 registered an increase but again in 1975 & 1976 the suicide figure registered a declining trend. The volume of suicides per lakh of population registered an increase from 8.4 in 1969 to 9.1 in 1970. The volume of suicides per lakh of population registered a declining trend till 1973. In 1974, the volume of suicides per lakh of population increased to 7.8 but in 1975 & 1976 it again came down to 7.2 & 6.8, respectively. The detailed statistics in this regard are set forth in Table No. 1. TABLE 1 Incidence and Volume of Suicides in India-1969 to 1976
